Immutable Diagram Revisions -- shared content with stable identity and explicit node continuity
|
|-- [M] Diagram is the content boundary shared by canvas, persistence, and agents
|   |-- Diagram.diagramId -> stable service identity across revisions
|   |-- Diagram.id -> local canvas content key
|   |-- Diagram.revisionId -> identity of one immutable payload
|   |   `-- Diagram.revision -> numeric content version; distinct from revision identity
|   |-- Diagram.content: DiagramContent
|   |   `-- ASCII and parsed structure travel together
|   |-- Diagram.sourceContext: DiagramSourceContext
|   |   |-- contentHash / mappings[] / evidence[entityId] / binding?
|   |   `-- DiagramSourceBinding -> sourceId / repositoryIdentity / corpus / domainProfileId
|   |-- Diagram.highlights? / Diagram.jumps? -> annotations attached to the content
|   `-- DiagramRevision -> id / diagramId / parentId? / diagram / nodeRefs
|       |-- id === diagram.revisionId; diagramId === diagram.diagramId
|       |-- nodeRefs[parsedNodeId] -> persistent logical node identity
|       `-- Canvas placement and context bindings remain outside the payload
|
|-- [M] Revision operations expose creation and change; construction stays internal
|   |-- createDiagram(input) / reviseDiagram(base, edit) / deriveDiagram(base, input, refs, sources)
|   |   `-- Return DiagramRevisionResult; retention and publication are separate operations
|   |-- [C] createDiagram(input)
|   |   `-- DiagramRevisionEditor.prepareCreate(input) -> constructDiagram(input)
|   |       |-- [D] input.ascii + `${input.id}:${input.revision}` + structureKind
|   |       |   `-- buildDiagramContent(...) -> content; default structureKind = 'diagram'
|   |       |-- crypto.randomUUID() -> diagram-* and diagram-revision-* identities
|   |       |-- [O] structuredClone() captures source, mappings, evidence, highlights, and jumps
|   |       |-- sourceContext.contentHash = content.asciiSha256
|   |       `-- validateDiagram(diagram) -> prepared diagram with empty nodeIds map
|   |
|   |-- [C] reviseDiagram(base, edit)
|   |   |-- Editor receives base.id -> base and local diagram.id -> base.id bindings
|   |   |-- prepareEdit('edit', base.diagram.id, edit) -> PreparedDiagramEdit
|   |   |   `-- diagram / nodeIds: old parsed ID -> new parsed ID / lineAfter?
|   |   |-- prepared.diagram === base.diagram -> return the existing revision
|   |   `-- Otherwise preserve base.diagramId and assign a fresh revisionId
|   |       `-- issueDiagramRevision(prepared, base) -> parentId = base.id
|   |
|   |-- [C] deriveDiagram(base, input, refs, sources)
|   |   |-- Every source.diagramId must equal base.diagramId
|   |   |-- [D] sources[].nodeRefs -> allowed logical identities
|   |   |-- prepareEdit('derive', ..., { kind: 'replace', ... })
|   |   |   `-- Claims already present in base.nodeRefs enter ordinary continuity checks
|   |   |-- refs[logicalRef] -> output line containing exactly one parsed node
|   |   |   `-- Reject unapproved refs, ambiguous lines, or two refs claiming one output node
|   |   `-- issueDiagramRevision(..., base, identities)
|   |       `-- May recover identities from supplied same-diagram revisions; parent remains base.id
|   |
|   `-- [C] issueDiagramRevision(prepared, base?, identities?)
|       |-- diagramContentNodes(prepared.diagram.content) -> nodes needing logical refs
|       |-- [D] Reverse prepared.nodeIds + base.nodeRefs + explicit identities
|       |   `-- Per-node priority: explicit identity -> retained base ref -> fresh node-UUID
|       |-- [O] deepFreeze({ id, diagramId, parentId?, diagram, nodeRefs })
|       |   `-- Issued revisions retain immutable content and identity records
|       `-- validateDiagram(record.diagram) -> return prepared metadata plus revision
|
|-- [M] DiagramRevisionEditor separates edit preparation from revision issuance
|   |-- Private revision(contextId, diagramId)
|   |   |-- [D] bindings(contextId)[diagramId] -> revisions[revisionId]
|   |   `-- Missing revision or mismatched diagram.id -> 'Unknown diagram'
|   |
|   |-- [C] prepareEdit(contextId, diagramId, edit) dispatches by DiagramEdit.kind
|   |   |-- 'source-mappings'
|   |   |   |-- expectedContentHash must equal before.content.asciiSha256
|   |   |   |   `-- Mismatch -> CONTENT_HASH_CONFLICT; caller must read again
|   |   |   `-- Clone mappings/evidence and optional binding -> validateDiagram()
|   |   |
|   |   |-- 'patch' / 'patches'
|   |   |   |-- patchDiagramRanges(before, ranges) -> diagram / nodeIds / lineAfter
|   |   |   |-- Explicit nodeCorrespondence -> correspondence() -> rebaseDiagramHighlights()
|   |   |   |-- 'patches' with retainMappings -> retainSourceMappings(..., lineAfter)
|   |   |   `-- Supplied mappings, when retention is not selected
|   |   |       `-- constructDiagram(...) supplies a validated replacement sourceContext
|   |   |
|   |   |-- 'replace'
|   |   |   |-- constructDiagram({ ...input, id: diagramId, revision: before.revision + 1 })
|   |   |   |-- correspondingNodes() + correspondence() -> nodeIds
|   |   |   |-- [D] Old/new content -> rebaseDiagramJumps()
|   |   |   |-- [D] Old highlights + nodeIds -> rebaseDiagramHighlights()
|   |   |   `-- retainMappings? -> retainSourceMappings(before, next, nodeIds)
|   |   |
|   |   `-- 'highlights' / 'jumps'
|   |       |-- validateDiagramHighlights(edit.highlights)
|   |       |-- validateDiagramJumps(before.content, edit.jumps, false)
|   |       `-- Keep content and infer exact node correspondence; validate resulting diagram
|   |
|   |-- [D] correspondingNodes(before, after) establishes exact continuity only
|   |   |-- Different ASCII or structure kind -> empty map
|   |   |-- Otherwise match line / startColumn / endColumn / label uniquely
|   |   `-- Heuristic preview matches never establish persistent anchors
|   |-- [C] Private correspondence(..., inferred, claims)
|   |   |-- claims[logicalRef] = outputLine; resolve ref through base.nodeRefs
|   |   |-- Require an old node, integer line, and exactly one output node
|   |   |-- Reject claims conflicting with inferred unchanged content
|   |   `-- Reject multiple old identities mapped to the same output node
|   |
|   |-- [C] resolve(contextId, diagramId) -> DiagramView
|   |   |-- diagramContentNodes() -> translate id / parentId / childIds through nodeRefs
|   |   |-- activeDiagramJumps() -> translate source.contentNodeId to its logical ref
|   |   |   `-- Omit source.revisionId and source.contentHash from the view
|   |   `-- [O] structuredClone(view) -> caller receives a detached view of retained content
|   |
|   `-- merge(baseline, current, proposed)
|       |-- Compare bindings for the union of baseline and current keys
|       |-- Any changed revision binding -> MERGE_REQUIRED
|       `-- Otherwise return { ...proposed }; automatic three-way merge is not implemented
|
|-- [M] Validation and source queries keep content tied to its backing evidence
|   |-- [C] validateDiagram(diagram)
|   |   |-- Require diagram-* / diagram-revision-* identities, local id, and nonnegative revision
|   |   |   `-- Legacy content lacking service identities requires offline migration
|   |   |-- Reject top-level ascii / mappings / diagramContent / structureKind
|   |   |   `-- Those fields belong inside content or sourceContext
|   |   |-- [D] content.ascii + local id/revision + structure kind + parser version
|   |   |   `-- buildDiagramContent(...) -> canonical content; serialized values must match
|   |   |-- [D] asciiSha256(content.ascii) == sourceContext.contentHash
|   |   |-- validateSourceBinding() -> supported profile/corpus pairing and absolute corpus root
|   |   |-- validateDiagramJumps() / validateDiagramHighlights() / validateDiagramLocalMappings()
|   |   |-- evidence[id] -> matching entry.id, label, and sourceRanges[]
|   |   |   |-- Ranges use relative paths without '..' and valid inclusive line bounds
|   |   |   |-- originalLines.length == endLine - startLine + 1
|   |   |   `-- Where supplied, evidence.sourceId must match binding.sourceId
|   |   `-- [D] mapping.entityId + sourceRangeIndex + optional sourceRangeId
|   |       `-- Must resolve to an existing, matching evidence range
|   |
|   |-- diagramSource(diagram) -> queryDiagramSourceContext(diagram.sourceContext)
|   |   |-- [M] Centralizes mapping/evidence joins for callers
|   |   |-- entries() -> { mapping, entity, range, binding }[]
|   |   |-- forSelection(rect) -> mappingsForSelection(...) -> joined results
|   |   `-- search(query) -> case-insensitive entityId / label / path / symbol matches
|   |
|   `-- sourceBindingFromLocation(location)
|       |-- Use supplied corpus or derive a git-worktree corpus from checkoutRoot/gitRevision
|       `-- [D] corpus.kind + corpus.root -> SHA-256 prefix -> sourceId
|
|-- [M] submitDiagramEdit() turns generated candidates into ordinary revision operations
|   |-- [C] submitDiagramEdit(request, raw, base?, correspondence?)
|   |   |-- Check requested baseRevisionId and base.diagram.id against request.input.id
|   |   |-- Reject replacementRanges when no base exists
|   |   |-- Context = base.diagram -> request.context.diagram -> constructed '[New diagram]'
|   |   `-- validateGeneratedDiagramEdit(context, raw, base?.nodeRefs, request.sourceMappings)
|   |       |-- [D] Validated candidate + caller correspondence -> generated edit
|   |       |   `-- Candidate nodeCorrespondence overrides overlapping caller claims
|   |       `-- source and evidence come from context.sourceContext
|   |
|   |-- Base plus editRanges/editRange -> scoped replacement
|   |   |-- Preserve the existing structure kind
|   |   |-- scopedReplacements(source, generated.ascii, ranges, replacementRanges)
|   |   |   `-- patches + outputRanges describe the actual replacement locations
|   |   |-- [D] Original mappings + edited ranges + output lengths -> shifted outside mappings
|   |   |   `-- Drop mappings inside old ranges; admit generated mappings inside output ranges
|   |   `-- reviseDiagram(base, { kind: 'patches', ... }) -> result with replacementRanges
|   |
|   `-- Otherwise request.baseRevisionId selects reviseDiagram('replace') or createDiagram()
|       |-- New diagrams start at revision: 0
|       `-- For revision edits, retainMappings = !request.sourceMappings
|           `-- Without requested source mappings, editor retention determines the mapping result
|
`-- [O] Runtime storage retains immutable revisions independently of canvas bindings
    |-- [M] Storage API -> domain operations + internal diagramRevisions registry
    |   |-- createStoredDiagram() -> createDiagram() -> retainDiagramRevision()
    |   |-- reviseStoredDiagram() -> getDiagramRevision() -> reviseDiagram() -> retain
    |   |-- deriveStoredDiagram() -> load base/sources -> deriveDiagram() -> retain
    |   `-- submitStoredDiagramEdit() -> load optional base -> submitDiagramEdit() -> retain
    |
    |-- [C] retainDiagramRevision(result)
    |   |-- importDiagramRevision(result.revision)
    |   |   |-- Every parsed node must have a nonempty, unique nodeRefs entry
    |   |   `-- diagramRevisions.register(revision)
    |   `-- getDiagramRevision(id) -> return the registry's canonical revision and diagram
    |
    |-- [M] RevisionRegistry hides records / signatures / pendingValidation
    |   |-- records: Map<revisionId, DiagramRevision>
    |   |-- signatures: Map<revisionId, JSON.stringify(record)>
    |   `-- pendingValidation: Set<revisionId>
    |
    |-- [C] register(record) -> install(record, false)
    |   |-- Verify record identities agree with its diagram payload
    |   |-- Existing revisionId
    |   |   |-- Different serialized record -> 'Diagram revision is immutable'
    |   |   `-- Same signature -> get(id), then reuse the retained record
    |   `-- New revisionId -> validateDiagram(record.diagram)
    |       `-- [O] deepFreeze(structuredClone(record)) -> store payload and signature
    |           `-- Caller mutations cannot alter the registry's captured revision
    |
    |-- [C] restore(record) -> install(record, true)
    |   |-- Check identity/signature and retain a frozen clone without immediate parsing
    |   `-- First get(id) -> validateDiagram() + validate logical node refs
    |       `-- Remove pendingValidation only after successful validation
    |
    |-- getDiagramRevision(id) -> get(id); unknown revisions throw
    |-- listDiagramRevisions(diagramId) -> frozen id / diagramId / parentId summaries
    |-- RevisionRegistry.assert(diagram) -> get(revisionId) + payload equality check
    |   `-- Accept the retained payload or an equal serialized copy
    `-- Durable adapters must flush retained revisions before publishing bindings
        `-- This registry provides runtime retention; no eviction or release operation is exposed
